before.body: Courtyard by Marriott is a Marriott select-service brand oriented to business and bleisure demand within Marriott International. For owners, the affiliation case is business demand capture, select-service operations, renovation or conversion diligence, and Marriott Bonvoy platform participation. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among AC Hotels by Marriott, Moxy Hotels, City Express by Marriott, Fairfield by Marriott.
